name: Pippin's Bravery — toggle left at No gives +2/+2
notes: Memory: project_asked_condition_toggles_2026-10-11. "You may sacrifice a Food. If you do, target creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn. Otherwise, that creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn." Whether the Food was sacrificed cannot be read off the board, so the spell has a toggle labelled "Sacrifice a Food" (the same mechanism as Kicked). Here it is switched to Yes.
